rows.ARS:
Medium red Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Bordeaux
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 2004).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2014 as 'Bordeaux'.
Introduced in United States by Newflora™ LLC in 2016 as 'Bordeaux Citiscape'.
Introduced in Australia by Treloar Roses in 2017 as 'Bordeaux'.
rows.Bloom: Scarlet - red, ages to fuchsia / magenta . Mild, apricot or peach, clove, green apple, tea fragrance. Average diameter 3.25". Large, full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, cupped-to-flat, rosette bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Semi-glossy, medium green, leathery foliage. 5 leaflets.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm). Width: up to 20" (up to 50cm).
